newsitem.title: SURINAM: Suriname's consumer prices dropped 0.8 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Suriname's consumer prices dropped 0.8 pct in 96.

text.p: Consumer prices in Suriname dropped 0.8 percent in 1996 as the small former Dutch colony began to put its economic house in order.

According to provisional and revised figures provided by the Statistics Bureau of Suriname (ABS), last year's result, in sharp contrast to previous years of hyper-inflation, was mainly due to the implementation of a tough economic reform program.
Currency markets began to stabilize at the end of 1995.
Prices rose 236 percent in Suriname in 1995, down from 368.5 percent in 1994, when the Suriname guilder suffered a massive devaluation.
